status_banner: Research-only paper-trading experiment. This breadth strategy failed its holdout validation and is not approved for real trading.

fx_locked.note: Locked at initialization and never re-read from a live feed. A paper result can therefore never move because the exchange rate moved. Changing this value invalidates the experiment.

costs.note: 0.05% round trip, charged as 0.025% on entry and 0.025% on exit. This is the 'base' scenario pre-registered for the study.

capital_model.model_note: Each of the 25 slots is its own self-contained paper account holding a fixed 100 SAR. Slots never share capital and never share profit: a win in one slot cannot fund a position in another, and a losing streak in one cannot shrink any other slot's next trade. Total notional is 25 x 100 = 2500 SAR.
capital_model.why_note: Replaced a single shared 100 SAR pool on 2026-10-10. This is a fidelity fix, not a preference: PREREGISTRATION.md section 3 measured the edge with every ticker evaluated independently and no shared capital pool, so the shared pool was a divergence between what was measured and what is simulated.
capital_model.sizing_note: FIXED sizing, not compounding: every trade commits exactly 100 SAR whatever that slot has made or lost. Realized P/L accrues beside the working capital instead of being added to it. For a study estimating a per-trade edge this is the right choice - compounding makes the result depend on the order trades happened to arrive in, which says nothing about whether the rule works. Set compound_per_slot true to let each slot compound instead.
capital_model.fractional_note: Allowed because 100 SAR (~27 USD) cannot buy one share of many US names. Not a claim that fractional execution is available anywhere.
capital_model.not_real_capital: 2500 SAR is notional and hypothetical. It is not real, allocated, invested, validated or investable capital, and the strategy failed its holdout test.

schedule.note: PROPOSED, NOT ENABLED. 22:00 UTC is after the US close in both EDT (18:00 ET) and EST (17:00 ET), and 30 minutes after the unrelated live tracker's own window, so the two never contend.
